# GEO report: orchard-site

**New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics.

## Code score: 98/100, Strong

Confidence: High (checked 23 of 23 points).
How it's calculated: low = 22.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 98. High = (22.5 + 0) ÷ 23 × 100 = 98.

This is a small, well-built Next.js site. Pages are server-rendered, and the sitemap, robots file, canonicals and metadata all line up. The only lost points are on the private account page, which has no description. These results are read from code, not measured on a live site.

## Live check

- **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL.

## Do these first

### 1. Add a description to the account page
- **Why it matters:** The description is one of the first things machines read about a page. This page is the only one without it.
- **Where:** `app/account/page.tsx:1`
- **What the code says:** `export const metadata = { title: 'Your account', robots: { index: false, follow: false } };`
- **Size:** Small
- **Score after this:** 100/100

## All results

| Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and reachable | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt`, valid lines, tiny file |
| GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access your policy says | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt:1-3` allows `*`. Only GPTBot and ClaudeBot (training) are blocked, which matches `trainingCrawlers: block`. |
| GEO-014 | Listed and linked pages are indexable | Clear | Not run | 3 of 3 sitemap and nav routes have no noindex. `/account` is noindex but isn't listed or linked. |
| GEO-015 | One absolute canonical on your domain | Clear | Not run | Canonicals on `/`, `/varieties` and `/visit` use `www.orchard.example`. |
| GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Clear | Not run | Server Components with no client fetching |
| GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | Not run | No JSON-LD in the project |
| GEO-011 | Sitemap is valid and discoverable | Clear | Not run | `public/sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt:11` |
| GEO-012 | Title, description and lang | Problem | Not run | 3 of 4 routes are clear. `app/account/page.tsx:1` has no description. `lang="en"` is at `app/layout.tsx:5`. |
| GEO-016 | Key pages reachable by real links | Clear | Not run | `app/layout.tsx:7` has plain `<a href>` links to all three public pages |
| GEO-017 | No snippet restrictions against AI search | Clear | Not run | No page-wide `nosnippet`. `data-nosnippet` at `app/layout.tsx:9` is scoped and deliberate. |
| GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Clear | Not run | Read the layout and 4 pages. No images or unnamed controls. |
| GEO-101 | Mobile app association files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared |
| GEO-010 | llms.txt (info only) | Not applicable | Not run | None present. Not scored. |

## Other problems found

None found.

## Worth considering

- **Label the opening times with structured data:** `app/visit/page.tsx:4`: `Open Thursday to Sunday, April to October.` This is a fact a `LocalBusiness` JSON-LD block could label. It would need a street address, which the page doesn't show yet. Adding the address as visible text and then labelling it might help machines read it.
- **Give varieties their own pages:** `app/varieties/page.tsx:4`: `Over forty varieties, from Ashmead’s Kernel to Worcester Pearmain.` The page promises forty varieties but names two. A page per variety, listed and linked from this page, would back up the claim in text.
- **Link onward from the home page:** `app/page.tsx:4`: `Grown in Herefordshire since 1952.` The page body has no links to Varieties or Visit. Only the nav does.
- **Add `lastmod` dates to the sitemap:** `public/sitemap.xml:4`. The URLs have no `<lastmod>`. If you have real update dates, adding them gives crawlers more to go on.

## Can't tell from code

- **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs <access log>` to check real crawlers against their published addresses.
- **Live status codes and headers:** whether pages return 200 and whether any `X-Robots-Tag` header is set outside the repository. A live scan would confirm both.

## Assumptions

- You want AI search tools to find this site, as `policy.aiSearchCrawlers: "allow"` in `geo.config.json` says.
- I counted the private `/account` page as a route for GEO-012, even though it is deliberately noindex. If you'd rather exclude it, the score is 100.

## What to do next

1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written.
2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-012`, to learn more.
3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL.

Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
